toolsPreview.name: sec_demo_latest_filings
toolsPreview.description: Preview the SEC filing response shape without an API key. Returns a small public sample only, then call sec_subscription_info for RapidAPI checkout, pricing, MCP config, and API-key setup links. Example no-key tools/call: name sec_demo_latest_filings with arguments {"limit": 2}. Authentication: no API key required for this public MCP setup tool.

toolsPreview.name: sec_subscription_info
toolsPreview.description: Return public pricing, checkout, documentation, and access links for SEC Event Intelligence without an API key. Use this after sec_demo_latest_filings to choose the free Basic tier or the $19/month Pro starter plan for production watchlist polling. Example no-key tools/call: name sec_subscription_info with arguments {}. Authentication: no API key required for this public MCP setup tool.

toolsPreview.name: sec_latest_filings
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a newest-first snapshot of public SEC filings. Use for initial dashboards or latest-form lookups when no polling cursor is needed; use sec_filing_changes for incremental polling. Authentication: requires a Data APIs key sent as x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer.

toolsPreview.name: sec_filing_changes
toolsPreview.description: Fetch filings observed on or after a since date for polling jobs that persist a cursor. Supports ticker/CIK, form, and event-type filters; use sec_latest_filings for a simple newest-first snapshot. Authentication: requires a Data APIs key sent as x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer.

toolsPreview.name: sec_watchlist_changes
toolsPreview.description: Fetch incremental filing changes for multiple tickers or CIKs, grouped into per-company buckets. Use for batch watchlist polling, alert fan-out, and dashboards that track a fixed issuer list. Authentication: requires a Data APIs key sent as x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer.

toolsPreview.name: sec_company_search
toolsPreview.description: Search the SEC company index by ticker, CIK, or legal name and return identifiers to pass into profile, filings, events, and insider-trade tools. Authentication: requires a Data APIs key sent as x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer.

toolsPreview.name: sec_company_profile
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one issuer profile with ticker/CIK identity, filing coverage, form counts, and latest known filing. Use after company search to verify the target issuer before retrieving filings. Authentication: requires a Data APIs key sent as x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer.

toolsPreview.name: sec_company_filings
toolsPreview.description: Return newest-first filing rows for one company, optionally narrowed by SEC form type. Use when you need accession numbers and filing metadata history, not normalized event categories. Authentication: requires a Data APIs key sent as x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer.

toolsPreview.name: sec_company_events
toolsPreview.description: Return normalized event records derived from one company's filings. Use when you need event labels and monitoring-friendly changes instead of the full company filing list. Authentication: requires a Data APIs key sent as x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer.

toolsPreview.name: sec_insider_trades
toolsPreview.description: Return public insider ownership filing metadata from Forms 3, 4, and 5, optionally scoped to one ticker or CIK. Use for insider activity monitoring, not trade recommendations. Authentication: requires a Data APIs key sent as x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer.

toolsPreview.name: sec_filing_summary
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve one normalized filing summary by SEC accession number, including issuer, form, filed date, source links, and concise summary fields. Use after another filing tool returns accessionNo. Authentication: requires a Data APIs key sent as x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer.
